data.headline: MacroMonitor Briefing: Elevated Stress (73.0/100)
data.executive_summary: As of 2026-11-20, the Financial Stress Composite registered 73.0/100, reflecting elevated stress. US Net Liquidity has expanded by $23.0B over the trailing 4-week window, while cash participants in India recorded net inflows (FII: ₹1,250.4 Cr) and recorded net inflows (DII: ₹1,840.2 Cr).

sections.title: Financial Stress & Volatility Breakdown
sections.content: The composite score is derived as the arithmetic mean of available cross-asset frictions: Equity: 99.3th percentile, Rates: 62.6th percentile, Fx: 45.6th percentile, Commodity: 88.4th percentile, Correlation: 58.5th percentile. No values are imputed for missing series.

sections.title: Funding & Institutional Positioning

In Indian equities, cumulative institutional absorption continues to reflect countercyclical domestic liquidity provisioning.
